$Comment: The skeleton every Harvest Feast quest inherits through Parent. It is never offered.
Season hides every quest built on it while the feast is off; a child that writes its own Requires
(the quest before it) keeps it, since Season is a leaf of its own. Hidden keeps each quest off open
lists, so it is offered only at the host, and RequirePrerequisites keeps a locked one out of sight.
Npc binds them all to the host (the role Harvest_Feast_Host), who takes the hand-ins, and
CompletionDialogue sends a finished quest back to the host's conversation.
A child adds its Listing (icon, category, order, its tier in the questline), its Requires, its
Objectives, its Rewards and any Repeat, and takes its words from the keys its id spells
(quest.<id>.title and .flavor). This file sits outside the _Harvest_Feast folder on purpose: its file
name already spells its id, so Parent names it the same way in the game and in the build's own
Name: Harvest_Feast_Quest_Base
